decision_conditions: The application contains significant inaccuracies, inconsistencies and omissions within the submitted plans. The drawings fail to clearly and accurately identify the development proposed and provide conflicting information regarding its scale, form, extent and appearance. The submitted plans are inconsistent with one another and with the description of development, such that the Local Planning Authority cannot establish with certainty the development for which planning permission is sought. As a consequence, the Local Planning Authority is unable to undertake a full and robust assessment of the proposal's impact on the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area, or upon the amenities of neighbouring occupiers. The proposal therefore fails to provide adequate information to enable the proper determination of the application and is contrary to Chapter 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), London Plan policies D3 and D4 (2021), CP4, CP5, CP6 and CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD 5, DMD 6, DMD8, DMD 9, DMD 11, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
